Insulin.  ​Insulin strategies for persons with T2DM may be-
gin with basal insulin at bedtime to suppress nocturnal hepatic 
glucose production and to normalize fasting glucose levels. 
Glucose-lowering medications usually are continued during the 
day. The next step is to add one mealtime rapid-acting insulin
